gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-duru-sans: Blockletter draws its squat, tall-bellied letters as if with a pencil that never presses harder, precise and modern. Duru Sans below is looser, with wide openings and big bodies.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-fresca: Fresca keeps its counters connected to the outside, with short ascenders over big bowls. Blockletter, the display heading, brings a tall-bellied, pencil-sketched precision, and the sans-serif text gives it somewhere quiet to land.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-funnel-sans: Blockletter has a tall midsection like a squat brush-pen belly, every letter sketched at a constant pressure, precise and modern. Funnel Sans keeps its stroke widths steady from stem to curve, a plain sans that lets that big, short heading do the talking.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-gafata: A marker-like constant line runs through Blockletter, with its tall, squat-bellied midsection feeling precise and modern. Gafata, a plain sans, counters with a tall band of letters, short stalks and wide-eyed lowercase e shapes made for running text.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-geist: Blockletter swells through a tall midsection, sketched with a pencil that never presses harder, precise and modern. And if that heading shrank, Geist, a quiet sans with words like solid blocks, would simply take over the room.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-georama: Marker-bold and squat, Blockletter holds its curves and straights to a single width. Georama, a sans-serif with a bracelet-wide c and barely rising capitals, would read in a friendly, approachable way across paragraphs.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-gidole: Gidole reads neutral and clean, with terminals parted like open scissor blades and a high-set midline. Under the precise Blockletter heading, this sans-serif would carry a long page in neon-tube strokes without tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-golos-text: Blockletter brings a tall, squat-bellied midsection, sketched as if with a pencil that never presses harder, precise and modern. Golos Text matches it with one stroke width and a full x-height.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-hedvig-letters: Blockletter joins its strokes without thinning or bulging, precise and modern. Its tall-bellied display shapes grab attention, while Hedvig Letters Sans, a plain sans with small letters nearly as tall as capitals, handles the approachable reading.
gen-dafont-blockletter-gf-heebo: Precise and modern, Blockletter keeps even its joins as slim as a pipe cleaner. Its display belly commands the top of the page, whereas Heebo, a sans with a tall central band and curves that stop short, carries the text.
